thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Paging oncall. Root cause unknown. Rolling back recent worker pool scale change as precaution.

maria: I’m on it, jumping into traces and logs now. Seeing a spike in OOM/errors around 10:02 UTC.

jonathan: Thanks — I’m here to coordinate customer comms & public messaging. Need a quick status snippet for the status page + a short twitter post.

maria: Root cause looks like an interaction between the new batching heuristic and a subset of queued requests causing KV cache thrash. Mitigation in progress: revert batching change + drain affected pods.

ops_lead: @maria ETA for mitigation completing? Any customer impact we should call out?

maria: Revert triggered, pods terminating & recreating. Expect ~8m to stabilize. Impact: increased 5xx for ~10-15m window; requests may have had degraded latency or errors. No data loss.

priya: Can we get a customer-facing line: who to contact and what they might have seen?

jonathan: Drafting. Want to keep social copy short and avoid absolute numbers until root cause confirmed. Also need legal/PR check if we mention region.

emma: I can run copy past legal. Quick Q: do we want a tweet pointing to the status page or to a blog? Status page is fine for now.

samir: Security note: don’t mention internal mitigations (e.g., revert). Keep to impact and remediation status.

jonathan: Understood. Posting two short options for social & status snippet; please pick and edit.

jonathan: STATUS PAGE SNIPPET (concise):
```
Summary: We are investigating elevated error rates for our text generation endpoint in the us-west-2 region.
Impact: Some requests may have returned errors or experienced increased latency.
Current status: Mitigation underway; traffic is being routed away from affected workers.
Next update: within 30 minutes or when there is a change.
```

jonathan: TWEET OPTION A: "We’re investigating elevated errors affecting /v1/generate in us-west-2. Our engineers are mitigating now — see https://status.redwood.com for updates."

jonathan: TWEET OPTION B (shorter, less specific): "Some users in US West may see errors or slow responses. We’re on it — updates at https://status.redwood.com"

emma: I prefer Option B for tone. Less technical, less region-specific wording might reduce confusion. But ops asked to include region earlier — tradeoff.

maria: From an ops standpoint including region helps affected customers triage, but ok if status page has region detail and tweet links to it.

priya: Draft customer email/snippet for high-usage customers:
```
Subject: Incident affecting text generation in US West — we're investigating
Body: Hi — we’re investigating an issue affecting the text generation endpoint in the US West region. Some requests may have returned errors or higher latency. Our engineers are actively mitigating; we will update you within 30 minutes. If you have critical flows impacted, reply to this email or contact support@redwood.com with your instance ID.
```

jonathan: Good. I’ll queue the status update and social copy. Need a quick legal/PR sign-off. @emma can you escalate?

emma: On it — pinging legal/PR channel and looping in @samir for security review.

samir: Security ok with the proposed language. Confirm we do not call out specific internal config changes.

ops_lead: Handoff note for next on-call: mitigation completed?

maria: Revert finished at 10:12 UTC. Error rates returning to baseline by 10:20 UTC. Recommend follow-up tasks:
- monitor for flapping over next 2 hours
- add an automated alarm for KV cache thrash metric
- schedule postmortem + RCA kickoff tomorrow

oncall-bot: Note: escalation log created: incident-1728456789. Postmortem task assigned to maria.

jonathan: Final social post we’ll send once legal clears: "Some users in US West experienced errors or slow responses earlier today. Our team mitigated the issue and services are returning to normal. Check https://status.redwood.com for details."

emma: Legal signed off quickly — minor wording change approved (replace 'earlier today' with timestamp).

jonathan: Publishing status update now and scheduling the tweet for immediate post. PR: @emma ok to publish?

emma: Go for it. Posting now. :thumbsup: 

priya: I’ve prepared the customer notification pack and added a note to support triage to escalate any reports with correlation id header.

maria: Leaving handoff: collecting logs & traces for RCA, will add timeline in postmortem doc. All clear to handover.

ops_lead: Thanks team — please update the postmortem doc with root cause and mitigation timeline. I’ll follow up with the exec summary.

jonathan: Closing thread for live comms. Will reopen if anything changes.
